newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-IRVINE FASTEST AS FERRARI DOMINATE PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-IRVINE FASTEST AS FERRARI DOMINATE PRACTICE.

text.p: Briton Eddie Irvine broke the track record as he topped the times by just one hundredth of a second ahead of his Ferrari team mate Michael Schumacher of Germany in Friday's opening practice for Sunday's San Marino Grand Prix.

Irvine, who finished a strong second in the Argentine Grand Prix at Buenos Aires two weeks ago, clocked a best time of one minute 25.981 seconds to raise the local Ferrari fans' hopes of seeing their team win on their home circuit.
The previous lap record for the circuit was set by Schumacher in qualifying for last year's race when he clocked 1:26.890.
Both Ferrari drivers were greeted by rapturous flag-waving from a big crowd for a practice day as warm sunshine bathed the circuit which is set in rolling vineyards south of Bologna.

Austrian Gerhard Berger, who will race in his 200th Grand Prix on Sunday, was third fastest for Benetton ahead of his team mate Jean Alesi of France. World championship leader Jacques Villeneuve of Canada was fifth quickest for Williams.
